description: Adds persistent, personalized long-term memory to LLM apps and agents with Mem0, the open-source memory layer: it extracts facts from conversations, stores them in a vector database and retrieves them in later sessions. Use when a user asks to make a chatbot or agent remember user preferences across sessions, add memory to an AI app, or search, update and delete stored memories per user.
